video_url.description: The source video, 5 to 30 seconds long, with no single shot longer than 15 seconds. The result keeps its length, motion, camera, cuts and sound.

reference_image_urls.description: One photo per new person, 1 to 4 photos. By default they replace the main people in the video from left to right, in every shot they appear in.

prompt.description: Who becomes whom, or what else to keep or change.

resolution.description: The resolution of the output video, where the number refers to the short side in pixels.

seed.description: Varying the seed integer is a way to get different results for the same other request parameters. Using the same value for an identical request will produce similar results. If unspecified, a random number is chosen.

enhance_realism.description: More natural skin textures and better blending of the new people into the scene.

webhook_url.description: A public https address on port 443 or 8443 that gets a signed POST when the job ends. Needs a signing secret: POST /v1/webhooks/secret. On /v1/responses it needs `background: true` and does not work with `store: false`. On /v1/images/generations it runs the generation as a task on the models that support it (the others answer 400 webhook_url_not_supported): the answer is { id, status } and the result is read with GET /v1/images/generations/{id}.

id.description: The ID of the generated video.

status.description: The current status of the generation task.

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

error.description: Description of the error, if any.

credits_used.description: The number of tokens consumed during generation.

usd_spent.description: The total amount of money spent by the user in USD.

x-codeSamples.source:
curl --request POST \
  --url 'https://api.aimlapi.com/v2/video/generations' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_AIMLAPI_KEY>' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"model": "minimax/h3-max-recast", "video_url": "https://example.com/input.jpg", "reference_image_urls": ["https://example.com/input.jpg"], "prompt": "Describe what you want the model to generate."}'
